scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @teamtrack/server" "npm run dev -w @teamtrack/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @teamtrack/server && npm run build -w @teamtrack/web
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:memory -w @teamtrack/server" "npm run dev -w @teamtrack/web"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --profile app logs -f server web
